From wounds to wonders.

Sugatta Care Foundation is a registered non-profit in Jind, Haryana. We bring health, comfort and learning to people who need it most: children, elders, women and rural families.

Every rupee goes to the work.

We are a Section 8 company. By law, we cannot pay profits, bonuses or dividends to any director or member. All money we receive is used for our charitable work.

We measure our success by the smiles we create and the lives we change.

How we help

We work on the ground, in villages and towns, with simple and practical support.

Health awareness

Camps and talks on cleanliness, good food and preventive care, so families stay well.

Elders and children

Care for senior citizens and old age homes. Food, clothes and support for children from poor families.

Education and skills

Learning materials to keep children in school. Job skills for women and young people.

Village and nature

Better village facilities, tree planting drives and quick help during emergencies.

Tax benefits for eligible donors

We are registered under Section 12AB of the Income Tax Act, so our income is tax free. More of your gift reaches the people we serve.

You get a tax receipt

We have Section 80G approval. Eligible donors can receive an official receipt to claim the applicable tax deduction.

Ways to give

Bank transfer

Send funds to our verified NGO bank account. Write to us and we will share the details.

UPI

Scan and donate with any secure payment app. Ask us for our official UPI details.

Give things

Donate clothes, books or health kits for our field projects.

To protect you from fraud, please confirm bank or UPI details with us by email before sending money.

Who we are

Sugatta Care Foundation is a registered, non-profit social welfare organisation. We began with a simple idea: help the poor, the elderly and the needy, with no personal profit motive.

We believe a strong society is built on kindness, equal chances and help that arrives on time.

Our vision and mission

Vision: A world where every person has basic healthcare, a life of dignity, and a safe place to grow.

Mission: Spread health awareness. Give care and comfort to people in need. Teach women and youth skills for work. Develop villages and protect nature. Stay open about every rupee.
